historical_references.context:
Sarwan Singh was the seventh and last human Maharaja of the Sikh Empire, ruling from Lahore.
He was the eldest son of Ranjit Singh, who established the Sikh Empire in 1799.
Sarwan Singh succeeded his father in 1839 and ruled until his death in 1840.
